answer.because: use_session at False measured 0 trades, so the session filter switch is inverted and blocks all entries when off. The fix is to make in_session true when use_session is false so the filter is disabled rather than all trading.
answer.script:
//@version=5
strategy("Day Shift Delta Volume Breakout Redesign 3", overlay=true,
  initial_capital=50000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1,
  commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=5.50,
  slippage=1, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false,
  max_bars_back=5000)

// ===== RISK =====
pv                = input.float(5, "Point Value ($)", minval=1, maxval=100)
stop_dollars      = input.int(250, "Stop ($)", minval=250, maxval=700)
tp_dollars        = input.int(500, "Take Profit ($)", minval=250, maxval=2000)

// ===== INPUTS =====
trend_len         = input.int(50, "Trend VWMA Length", minval=1, maxval=500)
trend_slope_len   = input.int(5, "VWMA Slope Lookback (bars)", minval=1, maxval=100)

rsi_len           = input.int(14, "RSI Length", minval=1, maxval=100)
rsi_long_low      = input.int(45, "RSI Long Low Threshold", minval=0, maxval=100)
rsi_short_high    = input.int(55, "RSI Short High Threshold", minval=0, maxval=100)
rsi_lookback      = input.int(10, "RSI Lookback Bars", minval=1, maxval=100)

use_session       = input.bool(true, "Use Session Filter")
sess_start_hr     = input.int(18, "Session Start Hour (ET)", minval=0, maxval=23)
sess_start_mn     = input.int(0,  "Session Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)
sess_end_hr       = input.int(16, "Session End Hour (ET)", minval=0, maxval=23)
sess_end_mn       = input.int(0,  "Session End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)

// ===== SESSION LOGIC =====
ny_time = time(timeframe.period, "0000-2359", "America/New_York")
ny_hour = hour(ny_time, "America/New_York")
ny_minute = minute(ny_time, "America/New_York")

in_session = true
if use_session
    start_minutes = sess_start_hr * 60 + sess_start_mn
    end_minutes   = sess_end_hr * 60 + sess_end_mn
    current_minutes = ny_hour * 60 + ny_minute

    if start_minutes < end_minutes
        in_session := current_minutes >= start_minutes and current_minutes < end_minutes
    else
        in_session := current_minutes >= start_minutes or current_minutes < end_minutes

is_flatten_time = (ny_hour == 16 and ny_minute == 0)

// ===== INDICATORS =====
vwma_val = ta.vwma(close, trend_len)
vwma_slope = vwma_val - vwma_val[trend_slope_len]

rsi_val = ta.rsi(close, rsi_len)
rsi_low_lookback = ta.lowest(rsi_val, rsi_lookback)
rsi_high_lookback = ta.highest(rsi_val, rsi_lookback)

// ===== SIGNALS =====
trend_long  = vwma_slope > 0
trend_short = vwma_slope < 0

rsi_cross_up = ta.crossover(rsi_val, 50)
rsi_cross_down = ta.crossunder(rsi_val, 50)

long_trigger = trend_long and rsi_cross_up and rsi_low_lookback < rsi_long_low
short_trigger = trend_short and rsi_cross_down and rsi_high_lookback > rsi_short_high

// ===== RISK MANAGEMENT =====
long_stop = strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_dollars / pv : close - stop_dollars / pv
long_limit = close + tp_dollars / pv
short_stop = strategy.position_size < 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price + stop_dollars / pv : close + stop_dollars / pv
short_limit = close - tp_dollars / pv

if strategy.position_size != 0 and not na(stop_dollars)
    if strategy.openprofit <= -stop_dollars
        strategy.close_all(comment="Open P&L > SL Risk")

// ===== EXECUTION =====
if in_session and strategy.position_size == 0
    if long_trigger
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
        strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
    if short_trigger
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
        strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

if is_flatten_time and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session End")

// ===== PLOTS =====
plot(vwma_val, "VWMA", color.blue, linewidth=2)
plotshape(long_trigger, "Long Signal", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.lime, size=size.small)
plotshape(short_trigger, "Short Signal", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.red, size=size.small)
bgcolor(in_session ? color.new(color.green, 95) : na)
